ruleset.name: PINT AE starter rules
ruleset.notes: Checked against PINT AE Billing 1.0.4 (docs.peppol.eu/poac/ae/pint-ae) on 19 October 2026: semantic model, shared PINT rules, AE specific rules and code lists. Each rule's source_reference names the clauses it follows; verify_note records where the check is narrower or wider than the specification.

labels.480: Invoice out of scope of tax
labels.81: Credit note related to goods or services

labels.O: Outside scope of tax / not subject to tax

transaction_type.verify_note: Confirm phase-1 scope (B2B/B2G) and treatment of B2C under the UAE e-invoicing roll-out.

currency_code.verify_note: ISO 4217 active currency codes (fund, metal and test codes excluded). Refresh from the ISO 4217 maintenance agency list before launch.

rules.description: Supplier TRN present: 15 digits, starting with 1 and ending with 03

params.format_label: 15 digits, starting with 1 and ending with 03

rules.fix_hint: Record your 15-digit TRN exactly as shown on the FTA VAT registration certificate (it starts with 1 and ends with 03), with no spaces, dashes or prefix.
rules.source_reference: PINT AE IBT-031 Seller VAT identifier; IBR-132-AE (TRN: 15 digits, starts with 1, ends with 03); IBR-134-AE (required except for invoice types 480 and 81)
rules.verify_note: PINT AE does not require it on invoice types 480 and 81 (IBR-134-AE), and sellers without a TRN may give a TIN in IBT-032 instead (IBR-177-AE); this check expects VAT-registered sellers issuing tax invoices.

rules.description: Buyer TRN, when given, is 15 digits starting with 1 and ending with 03; required on reverse charge invoices

params.format_label: 15 digits, starting with 1 and ending with 03

rules.fix_hint: Store each VAT-registered customer's 15-digit TRN (starts with 1, ends with 03) in the customer master and print it on the invoice. It is mandatory when any line is VAT reverse charge.
rules.source_reference: PINT AE IBT-048 Buyer VAT identifier (0..1); IBR-132-AE (TRN format); IBR-103-AE (required on reverse charge lines)
rules.verify_note: Optional in PINT AE for buyers without a TRN, so a blank value passes unless a line is reverse charge (AE). Under UAE VAT law a tax invoice to a VAT-registered buyer shows the buyer's TRN.

rules.description: Supplier Participant ID (Peppol endpoint) present in scheme:identifier format

params.format_label: scheme:identifier, e.g. 0235:1XXXXXXXXX (10-digit TIN) for UAE parties

rules.fix_hint: Your Participant ID is registered during ASP onboarding. Store it in the ERP company profile in the format 0235:<TIN>.
rules.source_reference: PINT AE IBT-034 Seller electronic address + IBT-034-1 scheme; IBR-081, IBR-062, IBR-CL-25 (CEF EAS list); 0235 identifier is the 10-digit TIN 1XXXXXXXXX (IBR-148-AE)
rules.verify_note: Mandatory in PINT AE. Kept as a warning because the Participant ID is usually set up with your Accredited Service Provider rather than held in the ERP export.

rules.description: Buyer Participant ID (Peppol endpoint) present in scheme:identifier format for B2B/B2G

params.format_label: scheme:identifier, e.g. 0235:1XXXXXXXXX (10-digit TIN) for UAE parties

rules.fix_hint: Add a Participant ID field to the customer master (format 0235:<TIN>). Your ASP can look it up on the Peppol directory.
rules.source_reference: PINT AE IBT-049 Buyer electronic address + IBT-049-1 scheme; IBR-080, IBR-063, IBR-CL-25; 0235 identifiers 1XXXXXXXXX (TIN) or 9XXXXXXXXX (predefined) per IBR-135-AE / IBR-149-AE
rules.verify_note: Mandatory in PINT AE. Kept as a warning because the Participant ID is usually set up with your Accredited Service Provider rather than held in the ERP export.

rules.description: Invoice number present
rules.fix_hint: Every invoice and credit note needs a unique sequential number from the ERP. Do not leave it blank on any line.
rules.source_reference: PINT AE IBT-001 Invoice number; IBR-002

rules.description: Invoice number unique within the uploaded file (no two different invoices share a number)
rules.fix_hint: Two different invoices carry the same number. Fix the numbering series in the ERP so each document number is used once.
rules.source_reference: PINT AE IBT-001 Invoice number (definition: a unique identification of the Invoice)
rules.verify_note: Checked within the uploaded file only.

rules.description: Invoice issue date present and a valid date
rules.fix_hint: Export the issue date as a real date (DD/MM/YYYY or YYYY-MM-DD), not free text.
rules.source_reference: PINT AE IBT-002 Invoice issue date; IBR-003, IBR-073

rules.description: Invoice issue date not in the future
rules.fix_hint: Correct future-dated invoices. The issue date must be on or before the date the invoice is reported.
rules.source_reference: Data-quality check (not a PINT AE business rule) on IBT-002 Invoice issue date
rules.verify_note: Catches mistyped dates; an e-invoice is issued on its actual issue date.

rules.description: Invoice type code present (380 tax invoice, 480 out of scope of tax, 381 credit note, 81 credit note for goods or services)
rules.fix_hint: Map each document to its PINT AE type code: 380 tax invoice, 480 invoice out of scope of tax, 381 credit note, 81 credit note related to goods or services.
rules.source_reference: PINT AE IBT-003 Invoice type code; IBR-004, IBR-CL-01; AE code lists: invoice 380, 480; credit note 381, 81

rules.description: Credit note references the original invoice number
rules.fix_hint: Link every credit note to the original tax invoice number in the ERP before posting.
rules.source_reference: PINT AE IBG-03 / IBT-025 Preceding invoice reference; IBR-055-AE (required for 381 and 81 unless the credit note reason code is VD)
rules.verify_note: The VD reason-code exception is not modelled because ERP exports rarely carry the reason code.

rules.description: Invoice currency code present (ISO 4217)
rules.fix_hint: Export the 3-letter ISO currency code (AED, USD, EUR) for every invoice.
rules.source_reference: PINT AE IBT-005 Invoice currency code; IBR-005, IBR-CL-04 (ISO 4217)

rules.description: Non-AED invoice shows the VAT total in AED
rules.fix_hint: For foreign-currency invoices, convert the VAT total to AED at the applicable exchange rate and show it on the invoice.
rules.source_reference: PINT AE IBT-006 / IBT-111; IBR-140-AE (tax accounting currency is AED), IBR-175-AE (VAT total in AED required when the invoice currency is not AED)
rules.verify_note: PINT AE also requires the exchange rate (BTAE-04, IBR-159-AE) and the total with VAT in AED (BTAE-20); this check covers the VAT total only.

rules.description: Line item description present
rules.fix_hint: Every invoice line needs an item name or description of the goods or services supplied.
rules.source_reference: PINT AE IBT-153 Item name (IBR-025); IBT-154 Item description (IBR-125-AE)
rules.verify_note: PINT AE carries both an item name and an item description; one description column is checked here.

rules.description: Line quantity present and numeric
rules.fix_hint: Export quantity as a number on every line (service lines usually use 1).
rules.source_reference: PINT AE IBT-129 Invoiced quantity; IBR-022

rules.description: Line unit price present and numeric
rules.fix_hint: Export the net unit price (excluding VAT) as a number on every line.
rules.source_reference: PINT AE IBT-146 Item net price; IBR-026, IBR-027

rules.description: Line net amount present and numeric
rules.fix_hint: Export the line amount excluding VAT as a number on every line.
rules.source_reference: PINT AE IBT-131 Invoice line net amount; IBR-024

rules.description: VAT category code per line (S standard, Z zero, E exempt, O out of scope, AE reverse charge, N standard rate additional VAT)
rules.fix_hint: Map every ERP tax code to a PINT AE VAT category (S, Z, E or O) and export it per line.
rules.source_reference: PINT AE IBT-151 Invoiced item VAT category code; IBR-SR-58, IBR-145-AE, IBR-139-AE; AE VAT category codes S, Z, E, O, AE, N

rules.description: VAT rate consistent with the line VAT category
rules.fix_hint: Standard-rated lines must carry 5%; zero-rated, exempt and out-of-scope lines must carry 0%. Correct the tax code set-up in the ERP.
rules.source_reference: PINT AE IBT-152 Invoiced item VAT rate; IBR-190-AE (standard rate 5.00), ALIGNED-IBRP-Z-05 (zero rated 0), ALIGNED-IBRP-E-05 / O-05 (no rate for exempt / out of scope), ALIGNED-IBRP-AE-05-AE (rate required for reverse charge), IBR-111-AE (additional VAT rate not zero)
rules.verify_note: Exempt and out-of-scope lines pass with a blank or 0% rate; PINT AE leaves the rate out, which the Accredited Service Provider mapping handles. Reverse charge and additional VAT lines expect the 5% rate.

rules.description: Line net amount = quantity x unit price (less line discount), tolerance 0.01
rules.fix_hint: Recalculate line net = quantity x unit price - line discount, rounded to 2 decimals. Check for prices stored with VAT included.
rules.source_reference: PINT AE IBR-147-AE: line net amount = quantity x (net price / base quantity) + line charges - line allowances
rules.verify_note: Assumes a price base quantity of 1 and treats line discounts as allowances.

rules.description: Line VAT amount = line net x VAT rate (zero on reverse charge and additional VAT lines), tolerance 0.01
rules.fix_hint: Export the VAT amount per line and make sure it equals line net x rate, rounded to 2 decimals.
rules.source_reference: PINT AE BTAE-08 VAT line amount (IBR-104-AE, IBR-123-AE); IBR-162-AE (zero on reverse charge lines), IBR-165-AE (zero on zero rated lines), IBR-108-AE (additional VAT tax amount is zero)
rules.verify_note: For non-AED invoices PINT AE needs the line VAT in AED as well; this check compares amounts in the invoice currency.

rules.description: Sum of line net amounts = invoice total excl. VAT, tolerance 0.01
rules.fix_hint: Invoice total excl. VAT must equal the sum of the line net amounts. Check for header-level discounts or rounding lines.
rules.source_reference: PINT AE IBT-106 / IBT-109; IBR-CO-10, IBR-CO-13
rules.verify_note: Document-level allowances and charges are not modelled: the total excl. VAT should equal the sum of line net amounts.

rules.description: Sum of line VAT amounts = invoice VAT total, tolerance 0.01
rules.fix_hint: Invoice VAT total must equal the sum of line VAT amounts. Align the ERP VAT rounding method (per line vs per invoice).
rules.source_reference: PINT AE IBT-110 Invoice total VAT amount; IBR-CO-14 (sum of VAT breakdown amounts); BTAE-08 line VAT
rules.verify_note: Compared with the sum of line VAT amounts, which equals the VAT breakdown when lines are rounded consistently.

rules.description: Invoice total incl. VAT = total excl. VAT + VAT total, tolerance 0.01
rules.fix_hint: Invoice total incl. VAT must equal total excl. VAT plus VAT total.
rules.source_reference: PINT AE IBT-112 Invoice total amount with VAT; IBR-CO-15

rules.description: Supplier legal name present
rules.fix_hint: Show your legal name exactly as on the trade licence and TRN certificate.
rules.source_reference: PINT AE IBT-027 Seller name; IBR-006

rules.description: Supplier address present
rules.fix_hint: Record your registered address in the ERP company profile.
rules.source_reference: PINT AE IBG-05 Seller postal address; IBR-008, IBR-009, IBR-143-AE (address line 1, city and emirate)
rules.verify_note: Checks that an address is present; PINT AE splits it into line 1, city, emirate code (AUH, DXB, SHJ, UAQ, FUJ, AJM, RAK) and country.

rules.description: Buyer legal name present for B2B/B2G
rules.fix_hint: Record each customer's legal name as per their trade licence in the customer master.
rules.source_reference: PINT AE IBT-044 Buyer name; IBR-007

rules.description: Buyer address present for B2B/B2G
rules.fix_hint: Record each customer's address in the customer master and include it in the invoice export.
rules.source_reference: PINT AE IBG-08 Buyer postal address; IBR-010, IBR-011, IBR-144-AE (address line 1, city and emirate)
rules.verify_note: Checks that an address is present; PINT AE splits it into line 1, city, emirate code and country.
